integrity: The proof is self-contained and the scripts check finite consequences. Originality may be limited by unindexed prior formulations; independent external validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Real fully independent signed hashes; \(m\ge2\); exact arithmetic; deterministic sketch-independent inputs. No hardware-speed or finite-precision inference; Gram-law failure for \(b\ge3\) does not compare all embedding tails.
source_date_note: The motivating SparseStack implementation (arXiv:2606.20195v1) first appeared on 2026-06-18; the finding is a distributional theorem about its exact fully independent signed-hash model. Prior SparseStack/OSNAP theory predating that preprint is credited as supporting and comparison literature.
title: Two-bucket SparseStack is exactly a dense Rademacher sketch up to a fixed rotation
